mapper.insert: insert into gym.seckill_order (order_no, user_id, activity_id, card_id, seckill_price, payment_method, status) value (#{orderNo},#{userId},#{activityId},#{cardId},#{seckillPrice},#{paymentMethod},#{status})
mapper.update: update gym.seckill_order set status = #{status} where order_no = #{orderNo}
